title: epipactis paludosa
intro: Epipactis paludosa, commonly known as Marsh Helleborine, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis paludosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as a vasodilator, making it useful in treating conditions like hypertension and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
